name: bcmath.scale
suspicion: OnUpdateScale writes process-wide BCG(bc_precision); only the ini value is swapped per request.

name: bcscale
suspicion: Writes BCG(bc_precision), the process-wide default scale, so every bcadd/bcmul/bcdiv in other in-flight requests that omits the scale argument silently rounds to this request's scale (money math).

name: date.timezone
suspicion: OnUpdate_date_timezone writes DATEG(default_timezone) process-wide; only the ini value is swapped per request, so ini_set('date.timezone') changes every other request's default zone.

name: date_default_timezone_set
suspicion: Writes DATEG(timezone), a process-wide module global freed only in the once-per-process RSHUTDOWN, so date(), strtotime(), mktime() and DateTime objects created without an explicit zone in every other in-flight request silently use this request's timezone.

name: dba_popen
suspicion: Persistent DBA handles are stored in the process-wide persistent list and shared by concurrent requests, so two requests iterate/write one handle's cursor and lock at once.

name: filter_has_var
suspicion: Checks the process-wide IF_G(*_array) snapshot, reporting variables from other in-flight requests.

name: filter_input
suspicion: IF_G(get_array/post_array/cookie_array/server_array) are process-wide arrays filled by php_sapi_filter while a request's variables are registered and freed only in the once-per-process RSHUTDOWN, so request A's filter_input(INPUT_GET, 'x') returns request B's raw GET value.

name: filter_input_array
suspicion: Reads the same process-wide IF_G(*_array) snapshots as filter_input(), returning another request's input.

name: bindtextdomain
suspicion: Binds a domain to a directory in libintl's process-wide table (also bind_textdomain_codeset), redirecting other requests' lookups.

name: textdomain
suspicion: Sets libintl's process-wide current domain, so gettext()/_() in every other in-flight request silently translates from this request's catalogue.

name: intl.default_locale
suspicion: OnUpdateStringUnempty writes INTL_G(default_locale) process-wide; only the ini value is swapped.

name: Locale::setDefault
suspicion: Alters intl.default_locale whose on_modify writes INTL_G(default_locale) process-wide, so NumberFormatter/IntlDateFormatter/Collator/MessageFormatter created with a null locale in other requests silently format in this request's locale (also locale_set_default).

name: libxml_get_errors
suspicion: Returns the process-wide LIBXML(error_list), which accumulates errors from every request's DOM/SimpleXML/XMLReader parsing since the list is only reset by libxml_clear_errors or process RSHUTDOWN.

name: libxml_set_external_entity_loader
suspicion: Installs a process-wide LIBXML(entity_loader) callback (closure bound to request A) that resolves DTDs/entities for every other request's XML parsing.

name: libxml_set_streams_context
suspicion: Replaces the process-wide LIBXML(stream_context), so request A's proxy/SSL/HTTP options are silently used when request B's DOMDocument::load() or simplexml_load_file() fetches a URL.

name: libxml_use_internal_errors
suspicion: Toggles the process-wide LIBXML(error_list) collection for all requests: request A enabling it makes request B's XML warnings vanish silently, and B's errors are appended to the list A later reads with libxml_get_errors().

name: mb_internal_encoding
suspicion: Sets MBSTRG(current_internal_encoding), a process-wide global reset only by the once-per-process RINIT, so every mb_* function in other in-flight requests silently switches encoding.

name: mb_output_handler
suspicion: A single process-wide MBSTRG(outconv_state)/outconv_enabled conversion state is shared by all output buffers using it, so concurrent responses corrupt each other's multibyte sequences.

name: mb_regex_encoding
suspicion: Sets the process-wide MBSTRG(current_mbctype) used by mb_ereg*/mb_split in every request.

name: mysqli_driver::$report_mode
suspicion: Property write goes to the same process-wide MyG(report_mode) as mysqli_report().

name: mysqli_report
suspicion: Writes MyG(report_mode), a process-wide flag consulted on every mysqli error, so a request switching to MYSQLI_REPORT_OFF around a query silently turns off exceptions for every other in-flight request (and vice versa).

name: odbc_pconnect
suspicion: Persistent ODBC connections in the process-wide EG(persistent_list) are handed to concurrent requests, sharing one connection and its transaction state.
evidence: ext/odbc/php_odbc.c (odbc_pconnect / persistent list); reasoning (same mechanism as pg_pconnect)

name: PDO::__construct (PDO::ATTR_PERSISTENT with pdo_pgsql/pdo_sqlite/pdo_odbc/pdo_dblib/pdo_firebird)
suspicion: For non-mysqlnd drivers nothing refuses persistence: pdo_dbh.c hands the same EG(persistent_list) handle to a second request while the first still holds it, so both run on one connection and B's queries land inside A's open transaction.

name: pg_pconnect
suspicion: Registers the link in the process-wide EG(persistent_list) and hands the same PGconn to any concurrent request with the same connection string, so two requests share one connection and transaction state (RSHUTDOWN rollback runs once per process).

name: posix_setuid
suspicion: Changes the credentials of the whole process, so every other in-flight request silently continues with the new uid (also posix_seteuid, posix_setgid, posix_setegid, posix_initgroups).

name: ReflectionClass::setStaticPropertyValue
suspicion: Writes the process-wide class static (same storage as Foo::$x), silently changing the value every other in-flight request reads unless the class is in fiber.isolate_statics.

name: ReflectionProperty::setValue (static property)
suspicion: Writing a static property through reflection updates the process-wide static members table shared by all requests.

name: session.use_trans_sid
suspicion: Trans-sid injects the session id through the process-wide BG(url_adapt_session_ex) rewriter (ps_globals are swapped, this BG state is not), so request A's session id can be written into request B's links and forms.

name: session_start (files save handler)
suspicion: mod_files takes flock(LOCK_EX) with a blocking syscall outside php_stream_lock(); when the lock holder is another suspended fiber in the same process the call deadlocks the whole process (proven), hence the opt-in files_arb handler.

name: SoapClient::__soapCall
suspicion: SOAP_CLIENT_BEGIN_CODE installs this client's sdl/typemap/class_map/soap_version in the process-wide SOAP_GLOBAL for the duration of the call; the HTTP request inside suspends, another request's SOAP call overwrites them, and the resumed call decodes its response with the wrong WSDL and class map (also SoapClient::__call and magic method calls).

name: SoapServer::handle
suspicion: SOAP_SERVER_BEGIN_CODE sets SOAP_GLOBAL(use_soap_error_handler)=1 and error_code='Server' process-wide while the user handler runs; any PHP warning in a concurrent non-SOAP request is routed to the SOAP error handler and turned into a SOAP fault response.

name: spl_autoload_register
suspicion: Autoloaders are appended to the process-wide zend_class_autoload_functions (ZEND_TLS is a plain global in NTS), so closures bound to request A's container object keep running for request B and the list grows with every request that registers.

name: chdir
suspicion: Changes the single process CWD, so relative paths in every other in-flight request (include 'config.php', fopen('cache/x')) silently resolve against request A's directory.
evidence: NOTES.md 3q (every per-request chdir is a bug); ext/standard/dir.c:345

name: chroot
suspicion: Changes the root directory of the whole process for every in-flight request and cannot be undone.

name: connection_aborted
suspicion: Reads PG(connection_status), a single process-wide flag set to ABORTED by php_handle_aborted_connection for whichever request's client dropped, so request B sees request A's abort and stops work silently.
evidence: main/main.c:2673; main/main.c:1850 (reset only in request startup); ext/standard/basic_functions.c:2123

name: connection_status
suspicion: Returns the process-wide PG(connection_status) (ABORTED/TIMEOUT bits) set by any in-flight request's connection, not this request's.

name: include_path
suspicion: OnUpdateStringUnempty writes PG(include_path), which php_resolve_path uses for every include/require without absolute path in every request, so request A's set_include_path silently changes which file request B loads.

name: output_add_rewrite_var
suspicion: Adds to the process-wide BG(url_adapt_output_ex) rewriter state, so request A's variable is injected into the links and forms of request B's output.

name: precision
suspicion: OnSetPrecision writes the process-wide PG(precision) used by float-to-string conversion, echo, var_dump and string interpolation in every in-flight request, while only the ini value is swapped.

name: putenv
suspicion: Modifies the single process environment and BG(putenv_ht), which is restored only in the process-wide RSHUTDOWN, so request A's putenv('APP_ENV=...') (phpdotenv with putenv enabled) is read by request B's getenv() and inherited by its child processes.

name: register_shutdown_function
suspicion: BG(user_shutdown_function_names) is process-wide and is only executed/destroyed by php_request_shutdown, which the fiber pool calls once per container, so callbacks capturing request A's objects never run at A's end (or run at process exit with everyone's callbacks) and the table grows per request.
evidence: ext/standard/basic_functions.c:1652-1734; NOTES.md 3u (no isolation of shutdown functions)

name: serialize
suspicion: php_var_serialize_init reuses BG(serialize).data whenever BG(serialize).level > 0, so if request A suspends inside __serialize/__sleep (lazy-load query), request B's serialize() shares A's back-reference table and both produce silently corrupt payloads; also reads process-wide PG(serialize_precision).

name: serialize_precision
suspicion: OnSetSerializePrecision writes PG(serialize_precision) (main.c:325), which serialize(), var_export() and json_encode() read process-wide, so a request setting 17 changes other requests' float output.

name: set_include_path
suspicion: Writes the include_path ini whose on_modify sets the process-wide PG(include_path) used by include/require resolution in every request.

name: setlocale
suspicion: Calls the C setlocale() for the whole process and BG(locale_changed) is only reverted at process RSHUTDOWN, so ctype_*, strcoll, localeconv, basename, escapeshellarg and printf('%f') in other requests silently switch locale.

name: stream_context_set_default
suspicion: Replaces the process-wide FG(default_context), so request A's default SSL options, proxy or HTTP headers are silently used by request B's file_get_contents()/fopen() without explicit context.

name: strtok
suspicion: BG(strtok_string)/BG(strtok_last) hold the tokenizer state process-wide, so a strtok(delim) continuation after any I/O switch point returns tokens from another request's string.

name: umask
suspicion: Sets the process umask; BG(umask) is restored only in the once-per-process RSHUTDOWN, so files and directories created by other in-flight requests silently get request A's permissions.

name: unserialize
suspicion: php_var_unserialize_init shares BG(unserialize).data across nested calls via BG(unserialize).level; a suspension inside __unserialize/__wakeup (e.g. Laravel SerializesModels DB fetch) lets another request's unserialize() reuse the same var_hash and resolve r:/R: references into the wrong objects.

name: msg_receive
suspicion: Blocking msgrcv() without MSG_IPC_NOWAIT; if the producer is another fiber in the same process it never runs, so the process deadlocks (otherwise it stalls all requests until a message arrives).

name: sem_acquire
suspicion: Blocking semop() without IPC_NOWAIT (unless $non_blocking=true); when the semaphore is held by another suspended fiber in the same process, the holder can never run to release it and the whole process deadlocks.

name: define
suspicion: define() writes EG(zend_constants), one table per process, so a per-request value (request id, tenant, APP_ENV) is visible to every other in-flight request and the second request's define() of the same name only warns and keeps the first value.

name: Fiber::suspend
suspicion: The request itself runs inside the scheduler-owned engine fiber, so Fiber::suspend() from the request's main context (outside a user Fiber) suspends the whole request into the scheduler, which logs and drops it.

name: Foo::$static (class static properties)
suspicion: Class statics live in the process-wide class entry (default_static_members_table), so a request-scoped cache/singleton stored in a static property is read by every other in-flight request unless the class is in fiber.isolate_statics.
evidence: frameworks.md (fiber.isolate_statics six-entry list); fiber_errors.md (Foo::$hits leaks under FPMNG_SHARED_INCLUDES)

name: ini_set
suspicion: Only ini_entry->value is swapped per request; on_modify callbacks that copy the parsed value into process-wide module globals (precision, serialize_precision, include_path, date.timezone, mbstring.*, ...) are applied to every in-flight request and are never re-run on fiber switch.
evidence: frameworks.md lines 376-381; sapi/fpmng/fpm/fpm_pool_coop_ini.c header ('What this isolation does NOT fix')

name: memory_limit
suspicion: One zend_mm heap and one limit per process; the limit applies to the sum of all in-flight requests and the fatal error it raises kills every coroutine in the process, not the offender.

name: require_once / include_once (FPMNG_SHARED_INCLUDES=1)
suspicion: With the shared included_files experiment require_once returns true on the second request without executing the file, so top-of-file side effects (define(), $GLOBALS assignments, setlocale, ini_set) run only once per process.

name: static $var (function-body static variables)
suspicion: Function static variables are stored in op_array.static_variables_ptr of the process-wide function table, so a memoised per-request value (e.g. static $config = null) leaks to other requests and is never reset per request.

name: ob_gzhandler
suspicion: All requests share the single ZLIBG(ob_gzhandler) deflate context, so two responses compressed concurrently interleave in one z_stream and produce corrupt gzip output or cross-request bytes.

name: bcadd (and bcsub/bcmul/bcdiv/bcmod/bcpow/bcsqrt/bccomp without explicit scale)
suspicion: Falls back to the process-wide BCG(bc_precision) that another request's bcscale() may have changed.

name: ctype_alpha (and other ctype_* functions)
suspicion: ctype functions use isalpha()/isdigit()/... under the process-wide LC_CTYPE, so validation results change after another request's setlocale().
evidence: ext/ctype/ctype.c (ctype_impl uses <ctype.h> under current locale); reasoning

name: curl_exec
suspicion: curl_easy_perform runs libcurl's own sockets outside the streams layer, so the whole process blocks for the full HTTP round-trip (Guzzle CurlHandler, Symfony CurlHttpClient).

name: curl_multi_exec
suspicion: Drives libcurl's sockets synchronously; combined with curl_multi_select it busy-waits or blocks the whole process.

name: curl_multi_select
suspicion: curl_multi_wait blocks the whole process until libcurl sockets are ready or the timeout elapses.

name: CurlHandle
suspicion: Every transfer on a CurlHandle goes through libcurl's blocking easy/multi API rather than intercepted PHP streams.

name: date
suspicion: Uses the process-wide default timezone (DATEG(timezone)) that another request's date_default_timezone_set() may have changed mid-flight.

name: date_default_timezone_get
suspicion: Returns DATEG(timezone)/DATEG(default_timezone) as last set by any request.

name: date_get_last_errors
suspicion: DATEG(last_errors) is process-wide and replaced by every parse in any request, so reading it after a suspension (or in a Carbon/Symfony validation path with I/O in between) returns another request's warnings.

name: DateTime::__construct
suspicion: Without an explicit DateTimeZone the object binds the process-wide default timezone another request may have changed.

name: DateTime::getLastErrors
suspicion: Reads the same process-wide DATEG(last_errors) as date_get_last_errors().

name: DateTimeImmutable::__construct
suspicion: Same process-wide default timezone dependency as DateTime.

name: mktime
suspicion: Converts using the process-wide default timezone set by any request (also gmmktime is unaffected; localtime/getdate are affected).

name: strtotime
suspicion: Relative parsing uses the process-wide default timezone set by any request.

name: filter.default
suspicion: Process-wide IF_G(default_filter) applies to input filtering of every request's variables.

name: FTP\Connection
suspicion: Every operation on the connection is a synchronous raw-socket exchange outside the fiber interception.

name: ftp_connect
suspicion: ext/ftp uses its own raw sockets (php_network_connect_socket_to_host, my_recv/my_send with poll) outside the intercepted transports, blocking the whole process (also ftp_ssl_connect, ftp_login).

name: ftp_get
suspicion: Data transfer loops on raw sockets block the whole process for the duration (also ftp_put, ftp_fget, ftp_fput, ftp_nlist, ftp_rawlist, ftp_mlsd, ftp_nb_* which still poll synchronously).

name: imagecopyresampled
suspicion: CPU-bound resampling of large images with no suspension point freezes all requests.

name: imagecreatefromjpeg (and imagecreatefrompng/gif/webp/avif)
suspicion: Synchronous file read plus CPU-bound decode of large images freezes every in-flight request for tens to hundreds of milliseconds.

name: imagejpeg (and imagepng/imagewebp/imageavif output)
suspicion: CPU-bound encode plus synchronous file write on the process.

name: gettext (and _, ngettext, dgettext, dcgettext)
suspicion: Translation follows the process-wide textdomain and LC_MESSAGES locale that any request's textdomain()/setlocale() may have changed.

name: hash_pbkdf2
suspicion: Iteration-heavy KDF is CPU-bound with no suspension, freezing all requests.

name: iconv.internal_encoding
suspicion: OnUpdateInternalEncoding writes ICONVG(internal_encoding) process-wide, the default charset for iconv_strlen/iconv_mime_decode/ob_iconv_handler in every request.

name: iconv_set_encoding
suspicion: Sets the iconv.* ini entries whose on_modify writes ICONVG(*) process-wide.

name: intl.error_level
suspicion: OnUpdateErrorLevel writes INTL_G(error_level) process-wide, changing whether other requests' intl failures raise PHP errors.

name: intl.use_exceptions
suspicion: Process-wide INTL_G(use_exceptions) changes whether other requests' intl failures throw IntlException.

name: intl_get_error_code
suspicion: Reads INTL_G(g_error), the process-wide last-error slot written by every intl call in any request.

name: intl_get_error_message
suspicion: Reads the process-wide INTL_G(g_error) message that another request's intl call may have replaced.

name: IntlDateFormatter::__construct
suspicion: With a null locale the formatter binds the process-wide INTL_G(default_locale) set by any request.

name: NumberFormatter::__construct
suspicion: With a null/empty locale the formatter binds the process-wide INTL_G(default_locale) set by any request.

name: json_last_error
suspicion: JSON_G(error_details) is process-wide and overwritten by every json_encode/json_decode in any request; a check separated from its decode by an I/O switch sees another request's error (also json_last_error_msg).

name: ldap_connect / ldap_bind
suspicion: libldap performs its own synchronous socket connect, TLS and bind outside PHP streams, blocking the whole process (also ldap_sasl_bind, ldap_start_tls).

name: ldap_search
suspicion: Synchronous ldap_search_ext_s waits for the directory server, blocking every in-flight request (also ldap_read, ldap_list, ldap_add, ldap_modify*, ldap_delete, ldap_rename, ldap_compare, ldap_exop).

name: ldap_set_option (null link, LDAP_OPT_X_TLS_*)
suspicion: With a null link the option is written to libldap's process-wide global defaults (TLS cert requirements, CA paths, debug level) inherited by every other request's new connections.

name: libxml_clear_errors
suspicion: Destroys the process-wide LIBXML(error_list) while another request is still collecting into it.

name: libxml_disable_entity_loader
suspicion: Deprecated; toggles the process-wide LIBXML(entity_loader_disabled) flag for every request's parser.

name: libxml_get_last_error
suspicion: Reads the last element of the process-wide LIBXML(error_list), possibly another request's parse error.

name: mb_detect_order
suspicion: Sets process-wide MBSTRG(current_detect_order_list) used by mb_detect_encoding without explicit list in every request.

name: mb_ereg_search_init
suspicion: Stores the search string/regex in process-wide MBSTRG(search_str/search_re/search_pos); an I/O switch between init and mb_ereg_search()/mb_ereg_search_regs() lets another request replace them.

name: mb_http_output
suspicion: Sets process-wide MBSTRG(current_http_output_encoding) used by mb_output_handler for every request.

name: mb_language
suspicion: Sets process-wide MBSTRG(language) used by mb_send_mail/mb_encode_mimeheader defaults in every request.

name: mb_regex_set_options
suspicion: Sets process-wide MBSTRG(regex_default_options) used by other requests' mb_ereg calls.

name: mb_substitute_character
suspicion: Sets process-wide MBSTRG(current_filter_illegal_mode)/substchar used by mb_convert_encoding in every request.

name: mbstring.detect_order
suspicion: on_modify writes the process-wide default detect order list.

name: mbstring.http_output
suspicion: OnUpdate_mbstring_http_output writes process-wide MBSTRG(http_output_encoding).

name: mbstring.internal_encoding
suspicion: OnUpdate_mbstring_internal_encoding writes MBSTRG(internal_encoding) and current_internal_encoding process-wide.

name: mbstring.language
suspicion: OnUpdate_mbstring_language writes process-wide MBSTRG(language).

name: mbstring.substitute_character
suspicion: on_modify writes process-wide MBSTRG(filter_illegal_mode/substchar).

name: mysqli_connect (p: persistent host prefix)
suspicion: Persistent mysqli links live in the process-wide EG(persistent_list); the fiber pool blocks them at the transport factory.

name: mysqli_connect_error
suspicion: Reads MyG(error_msg)/MyG(error_no), process-wide slots written by any request's failed connect (also mysqli_connect_errno).

name: mysqli_poll
suspicion: mysqlnd polls the connections with a raw select() on their descriptors, blocking the whole process for up to the timeout.

name: odbc_exec
suspicion: Synchronous ODBC driver I/O outside PHP streams blocks the whole process (also odbc_connect, odbc_execute, odbc_fetch_row).

name: openssl_error_string
suspicion: Drains the process-wide OPENSSL_G(errors) queue (fed by the thread-local OpenSSL error stack shared by all fibers), so a request reads errors produced by another request's TLS handshake or key operation.

name: pcntl_alarm
suspicion: alarm() shares the single ITIMER_REAL/SIGALRM with the Zend timeout for the whole process; disabled by the fiber pool.

name: pcntl_exec
suspicion: Would replace the process image serving N requests; disabled by the fiber pool.

name: pcntl_fork
suspicion: fork() would duplicate the whole process including every other in-flight request's fiber and sockets, so the fiber pool disables it (also pcntl_rfork, pcntl_forkx).
evidence: fiber_errors.md (pcntl block list, pcntl_fork duplicating process)

name: pcntl_get_last_error
suspicion: Reads PCNTL_G(last_error), a process-wide slot written by any request's pcntl call (also pcntl_strerror).

name: pcntl_setcpuaffinity
suspicion: Pins the whole process to CPUs for every in-flight request.

name: pcntl_setpriority
suspicion: Changes the scheduling priority of the whole process (default pid) for every in-flight request.

name: pcntl_signal
suspicion: PCNTL_G(php_signal_table) and SIGG(handlers) are per process, so a request's handler would fire for every request; disabled by the fiber pool (also pcntl_signal_get_handler, pcntl_signal_dispatch, pcntl_async_signals).
evidence: fiber_errors.md (pcntl block list); patches/0006 (persistent zend signal handlers)

name: pcntl_unshare
suspicion: Moves the whole process into new namespaces, affecting every in-flight request.

name: pcntl_wait
suspicion: Kept enabled but waitpid() without WNOHANG blocks the whole process until a child exits.

name: pcntl_waitpid
suspicion: Blocks the whole process unless WNOHANG is passed (also pcntl_waitid).

name: pcre.backtrack_limit
suspicion: OnUpdateBacktrackLimit writes PCRE_G(backtrack_limit) process-wide; a request raising or lowering it changes whether other requests' regexes fail with PREG_BACKTRACK_LIMIT_ERROR.

name: pcre.jit
suspicion: OnUpdateJit toggles PCRE_G(jit) process-wide and affects how patterns are compiled into the shared PCRE_G(pcre_cache) used by all requests.

name: pcre.recursion_limit
suspicion: OnUpdateRecursionLimit writes PCRE_G(recursion_limit) process-wide for all requests.

name: preg_last_error
suspicion: PCRE_G(error_code) is process-wide and reset by every preg_* call in any request, so a check after an intervening I/O switch reports another request's error (also preg_last_error_msg).

name: PDO::__construct (PDO::ATTR_PERSISTENT with pdo_mysql)
suspicion: Persistent PDO handles live in the process-wide EG(persistent_list) and would be shared by concurrent requests; the mysqlnd transport factory refuses them loudly.
evidence: fiber_errors.md (PDO ATTR_PERSISTENT desync, persistent blocked); ext/pdo/pdo_dbh.c:394-494

name: PDO::query (pdo_odbc)
suspicion: ODBC drivers perform synchronous network I/O outside PHP streams, blocking the whole process (also pdo_dblib and pdo_firebird).

name: PDO::__construct (pdo_pgsql)
suspicion: PQconnectdb blocks the whole process for the TCP connect, DNS and authentication round-trips.

name: PDO::query (pdo_pgsql)
suspicion: libpq PQexec is synchronous on libpq's own socket, so the whole process blocks for every query (also PDO::exec, PDO::prepare, PDOStatement::execute, PDO::beginTransaction/commit).

name: PDO::__construct (pdo_sqlite)
suspicion: Default PDO_ATTR_TIMEOUT of 60 s installs an in-process sqlite3_busy_timeout that sleeps in a loop; when the lock holder is another suspended fiber in the same process the busy loop can never succeed and stalls all requests for the full timeout.

name: PDOStatement::execute (pdo_sqlite)
suspicion: Synchronous disk I/O plus the in-process busy handler wait when another request in the same process holds the database lock.

name: pg_connect
suspicion: PQconnectdb blocks the whole process for connect, DNS and authentication.

name: pg_copy_from
suspicion: Synchronous PQputCopyData/PQputCopyEnd on libpq's socket (also pg_copy_to, pg_lo_import, pg_lo_export) blocks the whole process.

name: pg_get_result
suspicion: PQgetResult blocks until the server answers unless pg_connection_busy/pg_socket polling is used.

name: pg_query
suspicion: PQexec is synchronous on libpq's socket, blocking every in-flight request (also pg_query_params, pg_execute, pg_prepare).

name: phar.readonly
suspicion: phar_ini_modify_handler writes PHAR_G(readonly) process-wide (can only be tightened at runtime), so one request's ini_set makes other requests' Phar writes fail.

name: phar.require_hash
suspicion: phar_ini_modify_handler writes process-wide PHAR_G(require_hash) for every request's phar loading.

name: Phar::interceptFileFuncs
suspicion: Sets PHAR_G(intercepted) and swaps the fopen/file_get_contents/is_file/... handlers process-wide, so every other request's file functions start resolving phar paths.

name: Phar::mount
suspicion: Adds a mount to the phar's entry in the process-wide PHAR_G(phar_fname_map), visible to every request using that archive.

name: Phar::mungServer
suspicion: Writes the process-wide PHAR_G(phar_SERVER_mung_list), rewriting $_SERVER entries for other requests served from phars.

name: posix_get_last_error
suspicion: Reads POSIX_G(last_error), a process-wide slot written by any request's failing posix_* call (also posix_errno).

name: posix_getcwd
suspicion: Returns the process CWD that any request's chdir() may have changed.

name: posix_setrlimit
suspicion: Changes resource limits of the whole process for every in-flight request.

name: posix_setsid
suspicion: Changes the session/process group of the whole process (also posix_setpgid), affecting signal delivery for every request.

name: mt_srand
suspicion: Seeds the process-wide Mt19937 global engine, so the mt_rand()/rand()/shuffle()/array_rand() sequence of every other in-flight request becomes deterministic and predictable from this request's seed.
evidence: ext/random/random.c:485; ext/random/random.c:803-809 (RINIT resets seeded flag once per process)

name: srand
suspicion: Alias of mt_srand: seeds the process-wide global engine for all requests.

name: ReflectionClass::getStaticPropertyValue
suspicion: Reads the process-wide class static as last written by any request (also ReflectionClass::getStaticProperties).

name: session.save_handler
suspicion: The default 'files' handler is the one with the in-process flock deadlock; redis/memcached handlers through intercepted transports are the safe choice.

name: session_gc
suspicion: The files handler walks the whole save_path directory synchronously (also triggered by session.gc_probability in the per-request session RINIT), stalling all requests for the scan.

name: snmp_set_quick_print
suspicion: netsnmp_ds_set_boolean writes net-snmp's process-wide library defaults used by every request's SNMP output (also snmp_set_enum_print, snmp_set_oid_output_format, snmp_set_valueretrieval via SNMP_G).

name: snmpget
suspicion: net-snmp sends UDP requests synchronously with retries and timeouts of seconds, blocking the whole process (also snmpwalk, snmprealwalk, snmpset, snmp2_*, snmp3_*, SNMP::get/walk/set).

name: use_soap_error_handler
suspicion: Sets the process-wide SOAP_GLOBAL(use_soap_error_handler) for every request's error handling.

name: Socket
suspicion: All ext/sockets operations are raw blocking syscalls outside the streams layer.

name: socket_accept
suspicion: Blocking accept() stalls the whole process until a peer connects.

name: socket_addrinfo_lookup
suspicion: Synchronous getaddrinfo blocks the whole process.

name: socket_connect
suspicion: Blocking connect() (including its getaddrinfo) stalls the whole process for the TCP handshake.

name: socket_import_stream
suspicion: Turns an intercepted tcp:// stream into a raw Socket whose reads/writes bypass the fiber interception and block.

name: socket_last_error
suspicion: Without a socket argument returns SOCKETS_G(last_error), a process-wide slot written by every socket call in any request (also socket_clear_error).

name: socket_read
suspicion: recv() on a raw ext/sockets descriptor blocks the whole process until data arrives.

name: socket_recv
suspicion: Blocking recv() on a raw socket stalls the whole process.

name: socket_recvfrom
suspicion: Blocking recvfrom() stalls the whole process.

name: socket_recvmsg
suspicion: Blocking recvmsg() stalls the whole process.

name: socket_select
suspicion: select() on raw sockets blocks the whole process for up to the timeout.

name: sodium_crypto_pwhash
suspicion: Argon2 is memory-hard and CPU-bound for hundreds of milliseconds with no suspension point, freezing every request (also sodium_crypto_pwhash_str and _str_verify, sodium_crypto_pwhash_scryptsalsa208sha256).

name: spl_autoload_unregister
suspicion: Removes an autoloader from the process-wide zend_class_autoload_functions list while another in-flight request still relies on it, producing 'Class not found' in that request.

name: SQLite3::busyTimeout
suspicion: Installs sqlite3_busy_timeout, an in-process sleep loop; if the lock holder is another suspended fiber in the same process the wait always runs to the full timeout, stalling every request.

name: arg_separator.output
suspicion: Process-wide PG(arg_separator).output changes the separator http_build_query() emits for every other request.

name: array_udiff
suspicion: Uses BG(user_compare_fci) for the user comparator (also array_udiff_assoc/array_udiff_uassoc/array_uintersect*/array_diff_ukey/array_intersect_ukey); a suspension inside the callback lets another request replace it.

name: assert.active
suspicion: Writes process-wide ASSERTG(active) (deprecated), disabling assert() evaluation for every other request.

name: assert.bail
suspicion: Process-wide ASSERTG(bail) makes a failing assert() in any request bail out.

name: assert_options
suspicion: Deprecated setter that writes the process-wide assert_globals used by assert() in every request.

name: basename
suspicion: php_basename uses locale-dependent multibyte handling (mblen) under the process-wide LC_CTYPE another request may have changed.

name: clearstatcache
suspicion: Clears the process-wide single-entry stat cache BG(CurrentStatFile) used by all requests; conversely the cache is never cleared at request boundaries so file_exists/filemtime can return another request's cached result.

name: crypt
suspicion: Synchronous bcrypt/sha512-crypt with configurable rounds freezes the process.

name: default_socket_timeout
suspicion: OnUpdateLong writes FG(default_socket_timeout) process-wide, so a request setting a short timeout makes other requests' new connections (mysqlnd, redis, http wrapper) time out early.

name: display_errors
suspicion: OnUpdateDisplayErrors writes PG(display_errors) process-wide, so request A's ini_set('display_errors', 1) makes request B print its warnings into its response.

name: dns_check_record
suspicion: Synchronous resolver query (also checkdnsrr alias) blocks the whole process.

name: dns_get_mx
suspicion: Synchronous MX lookup (also getmxrr alias) blocks the whole process.

name: dns_get_record
suspicion: Synchronous res_nsearch/res_search blocks the whole process for the DNS round-trip and retries.

name: error_clear_last
suspicion: Clears the process-wide PG(last_error_*) fields, discarding an error another in-flight request has not yet read.

name: error_get_last
suspicion: PG(last_error_message)/type/file/line are process-wide and are overwritten by any warning raised in another request between this request's failing call and its error_get_last() (any I/O in between is a switch point).

name: error_log
suspicion: on_modify writes PG(error_log) process-wide, so errors of request B are logged to the file request A configured with ini_set('error_log').

name: escapeshellarg
suspicion: Uses locale-dependent mblen() under the process-wide LC_CTYPE, so quoting of multibyte arguments follows another request's setlocale().

name: exec
suspicion: fork+exec then a blocking read of the child's stdout until it exits; the whole process (all in-flight requests) stalls for the child's lifetime.

name: fdatasync
suspicion: fdatasync(2) waits for the disk, stalling every in-flight request.

name: fopen (FIFO or php://stdin)
suspicion: Opening a FIFO blocks until a writer appears and reading php://stdin blocks on the shared process stdin indefinitely.

name: fsync
suspicion: fsync(2) waits for the disk to flush, stalling every in-flight request for milliseconds to seconds.

name: get_include_path
suspicion: Returns the process-wide PG(include_path) another request may have changed.

name: getcwd
suspicion: Returns the process CWD, which reflects the last chdir() of any request rather than this request's script directory (the pool deliberately skips the per-script chdir).
evidence: sapi/fpmng/fpm/fpm_pool_coop.c (zend_execute_scripts instead of php_execute_script to avoid chdir); ext/standard/dir.c:379

name: getenv
suspicion: Reads the process environment that any concurrent request may have changed with putenv().

name: gethostbyaddr
suspicion: Synchronous reverse lookup blocks the whole process.

name: gethostbyname
suspicion: Synchronous resolver call outside the evdns-backed connect path blocks the whole process for the DNS round-trip.

name: gethostbynamel
suspicion: Synchronous getaddrinfo outside the intercepted connect path blocks the whole process.

name: getlastmod
suspicion: BG(page_mtime)/page_inode cache is filled by the first script that asks and reset only at process RSHUTDOWN, so in a pool serving several scripts other requests get the first script's mtime.

name: getmyinode
suspicion: Same BG(page_inode) once-per-process cache as getlastmod.

name: ignore_user_abort
suspicion: Writes the ini entry whose on_modify updates the process-wide PG(ignore_user_abort), so request A's ignore_user_abort(true) also stops request B from bailing out when B's client disconnects.

name: ignore_user_abort
suspicion: on_modify writes the process-wide PG(ignore_user_abort) consulted when any request's client aborts.

name: internal_encoding
suspicion: Process-wide PG(internal_encoding) is the fallback charset for htmlspecialchars/mbstring/iconv in every request.

name: localeconv
suspicion: Returns the process-wide C locale numeric/monetary data that another request's setlocale() may have changed.

name: log_errors
suspicion: Process-wide PG(log_errors), so one request disabling error logging silences other requests' errors in the log.

name: mail
suspicion: popen()s sendmail and writes the message through a blocking pipe then pclose() waits for the MTA, stalling all requests for the sendmail round-trip.

name: memory_get_peak_usage
suspicion: Peak is process-wide and never reset per request, so it reflects the busiest moment of any concurrent request.

name: memory_get_usage
suspicion: Reports the single process heap shared by all in-flight requests, so per-request memory accounting (Symfony profiler, Laravel Telescope, memory guards) is inflated by other requests.
evidence: reasoning (one zend_mm heap per process; NOTES.md 3s memory_limit per process)

name: nl_langinfo
suspicion: Reads process-wide C locale data changed by any request's setlocale().

name: open_basedir
suspicion: OnUpdateBaseDir tightens PG(open_basedir) for the whole process, so a request narrowing its own open_basedir at runtime makes other requests fail with 'open_basedir restriction in effect'.

name: openlog
suspicion: Sets the process-wide syslog ident/facility (BG(syslog_device)), so another request's syslog() lines are tagged with this request's ident.

name: output_reset_rewrite_vars
suspicion: Resets the process-wide output rewriter while another request still expects its variables to be appended.

name: passthru
suspicion: Blocking read of the child's output until exit stalls every in-flight request.

name: password_hash
suspicion: bcrypt/argon2 hashing is CPU-bound for 50-500 ms with no suspension point, freezing every other in-flight request for that time.

name: password_verify
suspicion: Recomputes the bcrypt/argon2 hash synchronously, freezing all requests for the hash cost.

name: pclose
suspicion: Waits for the child process to exit, stalling every in-flight request.

name: pfsockopen
suspicion: Persistent socket via EG(persistent_list) shared by all in-flight requests; refused by the fiber transport factory.

name: popen
suspicion: Returns a plain (non-intercepted) pipe stream; fgets/fread on it and pclose()'s wait block the whole process until the child writes or exits.

name: proc_close
suspicion: waitpid() without WNOHANG on the child stalls every in-flight request until it exits.

name: proc_nice
suspicion: Changes the nice value of the whole process, slowing or prioritising every in-flight request.

name: proc_open
suspicion: Child pipes are plain streams outside the transport interception, so reading them (Symfony Process) blocks the process; proc_close()/resource dtor waitpid() blocks until exit.

name: register_tick_function
suspicion: BG(user_tick_functions) is a process-wide list run from the tick hook, so request A's tick callback fires while request B's declare(ticks) code executes and the list is only destroyed at process RSHUTDOWN.

name: set_time_limit
suspicion: Arms the single process-wide Zend timeout (setitimer) for whatever code happens to be running when it fires; the pool restores max_execution_time after the script but a request-scoped limit still applies to everyone.

name: shell_exec
suspicion: Blocking popen/read until the child exits stalls every in-flight request.

name: sprintf (%f and %F with locale-aware conversion)
suspicion: The lowercase %f conversion uses localeconv() decimal point of the process-wide locale another request may have set.

name: strcoll
suspicion: Locale-dependent collation follows the process-wide LC_COLLATE set by another request's setlocale().

name: stream_context_get_default
suspicion: Returns and lets the caller mutate the process-wide FG(default_context) shared by all requests.

name: stream_filter_register
suspicion: Registers into the process-wide BG(user_filter_map); the second request registering the same filter name gets a warning and false, and filter classes bound to another request stay resolvable.

name: stream_socket_client (STREAM_CLIENT_PERSISTENT)
suspicion: Persistent transports live in the process-wide EG(persistent_list) and would be handed to concurrent requests, so the fiber transport factory refuses them loudly.

name: stream_socket_client (udp:// and udg:// transports)
suspicion: Only tcp, unix and TLS transport factories are replaced; udp/udg streams keep the blocking xp_socket ops, so fread() waiting for a datagram (statsd, syslog, DNS-over-UDP libraries) stalls the process.
evidence: sapi/fpmng/fpm/fpm_pool_fiber_xport.c (registers tcp and unix only); main/streams/xp_socket.c

name: stream_wrapper_register
suspicion: Registers into FG(stream_wrappers), a process-wide copy of the wrapper table only freed at process RSHUTDOWN, so wrappers (vfs mocks, custom s3://) appear in other requests and the second request gets 'Protocol already registered'.

name: stream_wrapper_unregister
suspicion: Removes a wrapper from the process-wide FG(stream_wrappers) (a common hardening step for phar://), breaking that scheme for other in-flight requests.

name: syslog
suspicion: Logs under whichever ident/facility the last openlog() of any request set; closelog() by another request resets it mid-request.

name: system
suspicion: Blocking popen/read loop until the child exits stalls every in-flight request.

name: time_sleep_until
suspicion: Not swapped by the sleep interception (only sleep/usleep/time_nanosleep are), so it blocks the whole process until the given timestamp.

name: uasort
suspicion: Same BG(user_compare_fci) sharing as usort: a suspension inside the comparator lets another request replace the callback.

name: uksort
suspicion: Same BG(user_compare_fci) sharing as usort.

name: unserialize_callback_func
suspicion: Process-wide PG(unserialize_callback_func) is called by unserialize() in any request when a class is missing, so request A's callback (e.g. an autoloader closure name) runs for request B's payloads.

name: usort
suspicion: The comparator is stored in the process-wide BG(user_compare_fci); if the callback suspends (DB call inside a comparator) another request's usort overwrites it and this sort resumes calling the wrong callback.

name: msg_send
suspicion: Blocking msgsnd() when the queue is full (blocking=true default) stalls the whole process until a consumer drains it.

name: class_alias
suspicion: class_alias() inserts into the process-wide EG(class_table); the second request executing the same alias gets 'Cannot declare class X, because the name is already in use' and returns false.
evidence: Zend/zend_builtin_functions.c ZEND_FUNCTION(class_alias); reasoning (same table as class declarations)

name: const (top-level constant declaration)
suspicion: A top-level const in the entry script registers into the process-wide EG(zend_constants); when the script is recompiled for the next request the declaration fails with 'Constant X already defined' and any changed value is silently ignored.

name: exit
suspicion: exit() longjmps to the fiber-local EG(bailout) so only the request unwinds, but it skips the request's own shutdown functions (run once per process) and leaves CG(unclean_shutdown) set for the shared engine.

name: Fiber::getCurrent
suspicion: Returns the SAPI's engine fiber instead of null, so libraries that check Fiber::getCurrent() to decide whether they run inside a user fiber (Revolt/amphp, Laravel Concurrency) take the wrong path.
evidence: reasoning (zend_fibers.c: EG(active_fiber) is the scheduler-started fiber)

name: Fiber::start / Fiber::resume (I/O inside a nested user Fiber)
suspicion: Inside a user-created Fiber the interception layer cannot suspend to the scheduler (can_wait()==0) and falls back to blocking I/O, stalling every request in the process.
evidence: NOTES.md 3x (nested user Fiber can_wait()==0 falls back to blocking)

name: gc_disable
suspicion: Disables cycle collection for the whole process (GC_G is not per request), so cyclic garbage from every other in-flight request accumulates until memory_limit kills all of them.

name: gc_enable
suspicion: Toggles zend.enable_gc / GC_G(gc_enabled) for the whole process, so one request's gc_enable() overrides another's gc_disable() while both are in flight.

name: ini_restore
suspicion: Restores the ini VALUE but re-runs on_modify, writing the baseline back into a process-wide global while another request expects its own runtime value there.

name: require / include (files declaring functions or classes)
suspicion: EG(included_files) is per request but EG(function_table)/EG(class_table) are per process, so the second request that includes a file declaring a named class or function dies with 'Cannot redeclare'.

name: trigger_error (E_USER_ERROR) / fatal errors
suspicion: A bailout in the middle of C code leaves process-wide module state (BG(serialize).level, MBSTRG outconv state, SOAP_GLOBAL, ZLIBG(ob_gzhandler)) as it was, and the next request in the same process inherits it.

name: zend.assertions
suspicion: OnUpdateAssertions writes EG(assertions) process-wide (values can only be lowered at runtime), so a request setting 0 disables assert() for every other in-flight request.

name: zend.enable_gc
suspicion: OnUpdateGCEnabled toggles the process-wide collector for all requests.

name: zend.exception_ignore_args
suspicion: Process-wide EG(exception_ignore_args); a request enabling argument capture exposes argument values (passwords) in other requests' stack traces.

name: ZipArchive::close
suspicion: Compresses and writes all pending entries synchronously on the process.

name: ZipArchive::extractTo
suspicion: Synchronous decompression and file writes for the whole archive can take seconds, freezing every request.

name: zlib.output_compression
suspicion: OnUpdate_zlib_output_compression writes ZLIBG(output_compression) process-wide and at runtime starts the handler; a request toggling it changes whether other requests' output is compressed.

name: bzopen / bzread / bzwrite
suspicion: Compressed plain-file I/O plus CPU-bound bzip2 on the process.

name: strftime
suspicion: Deprecated; formats through the C library using the process-wide locale and timezone another request may have changed.

name: dba_open
suspicion: Synchronous file-backed database I/O; the default lock file uses php_stream_lock (intercepted).

name: DOMDocument::load
suspicion: Loading a local file goes through libxml's synchronous file I/O (http:// URLs use intercepted PHP streams); also DOMDocument::loadHTMLFile, DOMDocument::save.

name: exif.encode_unicode
suspicion: OnUpdateEncode writes EXIF_G(encode_unicode) process-wide for all requests' EXIF decoding (also exif.decode_unicode_*, exif.encode_jis, exif.decode_jis_*).

name: exif_read_data
suspicion: Synchronous plain-file read of the image header (also exif_thumbnail, exif_imagetype).

name: finfo_file
suspicion: Synchronous read of the target file and, on first use, of the magic database (also finfo_open, mime_content_type, finfo::file).

name: hash_file
suspicion: Reads the file through the plain wrapper synchronously (also hash_hmac_file, hash_update_file).

name: iconv.input_encoding
suspicion: on_modify writes process-wide ICONVG(input_encoding).

name: iconv.output_encoding
suspicion: on_modify writes process-wide ICONVG(output_encoding) used by ob_iconv_handler in every request.

name: json_encode
suspicion: Float formatting follows the process-wide PG(serialize_precision) another request may have set through ini_set.

name: mb_http_input
suspicion: Returns MBSTRG(http_input_identify), which is set during input decoding and overwritten process-wide by the next request's input.

name: mbstring.http_input
suspicion: on_modify writes the process-wide http input encoding list used at input decoding.

name: mbstring.regex_retry_limit
suspicion: OnUpdateLong writes process-wide MBSTRG(regex_retry_limit) for all mb_ereg calls.

name: mbstring.regex_stack_limit
suspicion: OnUpdateLong writes process-wide MBSTRG(regex_stack_limit) for all mb_ereg calls.

name: mysqli_get_client_stats
suspicion: mysqlnd statistics are per process and never reset per request because mysqlnd RINIT/RSHUTDOWN run once per container.

name: opcache.enable
suspicion: The fiber executor refuses to start with OPcache enabled (shared memory script cache assumes one request per process), so opcache_* functions are unavailable and every request recompiles its script.

name: openssl_pkey_new
suspicion: RSA key generation is CPU-bound for hundreds of milliseconds with no suspension point, freezing all requests.

name: openssl_x509_export_to_file
suspicion: Writes through a blocking plain-file BIO (also openssl_pkey_export_to_file, openssl_csr_export_to_file, openssl_pkcs12_export_to_file).

name: ssl.allow_blocking (stream context option)
suspicion: TLS contexts requesting blocking mode cannot be intercepted, so the fiber build refuses the connect with a warning instead of silently blocking.

name: pcntl_sigprocmask
suspicion: Process-wide signal mask change; disabled by the fiber pool (also pcntl_sigwaitinfo, pcntl_sigtimedwait which would also block).

name: Phar::__construct / phar:// wrapper
suspicion: Reading and extracting archive entries is synchronous plain-file I/O on the process.

name: posix_mkfifo
suspicion: Opening the created FIFO with fopen() blocks the process until the other end appears.

name: mt_rand
suspicion: Consumes the process-wide global Mt19937 stream, so sequences interleave across requests and a seed set by another request applies.

name: rand
suspicion: Same process-wide global engine as mt_rand.

name: readline
suspicion: Blocks on the shared process stdin until a line arrives.

name: ReflectionFunction::getStaticVariables
suspicion: Returns the function's process-wide static variables as last set by any request.

name: session.auto_start
suspicion: Auto-start would open the session in a per-process RINIT before the per-request session swap, so the fiber pool refuses it.

name: session_regenerate_id (files save handler)
suspicion: Creates and unlinks session files with blocking plain-file syscalls; the new file is opened with the same blocking flock.

name: session_write_close (files save handler)
suspicion: Writes the session file with blocking plain-file I/O and releases the flock.

name: simplexml_load_file
suspicion: Local file parsing uses synchronous I/O on the process.

name: soap.wsdl_cache_enabled
suspicion: Process-wide SOAP_GLOBAL(cache_enabled) toggles WSDL caching for every request (also soap.wsdl_cache_dir, soap.wsdl_cache_ttl, soap.wsdl_cache_limit).

name: SoapClient::__construct (file WSDL)
suspicion: Parsing a WSDL from a local path uses synchronous file I/O; the disk WSDL cache in soap.wsdl_cache_dir is also read/written synchronously.

name: DirectoryIterator::__construct
suspicion: opendir/readdir are synchronous on the process (also FilesystemIterator, RecursiveDirectoryIterator, GlobIterator).

name: spl_autoload_extensions
suspicion: Sets SPL_G(autoload_extensions), a process-wide module global used by spl_autoload() for every other request.

name: spl_autoload_functions
suspicion: Returns the process-wide autoloader list, including callables registered by other in-flight requests.

name: SplFileObject::__construct
suspicion: Plain-file stream; fgets/fwrite/fgetcsv are synchronous on the process, while SplFileObject::flock is intercepted via php_stream_lock().

name: SplTempFileObject::__construct
suspicion: Beyond the memory threshold php://temp spills to a plain temporary file with synchronous I/O.

name: SQLite3::exec
suspicion: Synchronous disk I/O on the process (also SQLite3::query, SQLite3Stmt::execute); fast on local disk unless busyTimeout is set.

name: array_rand
suspicion: Draws from the process-wide global random engine seeded by any request's mt_srand().

name: assert.exception
suspicion: Process-wide ASSERTG(exception) changes assert() failure behaviour for every request.

name: assert.warning
suspicion: Process-wide ASSERTG(warning) changes assert() failure behaviour for every request.

name: auto_detect_line_endings
suspicion: Process-wide FG(auto_detect_line_endings) changes fgets() line splitting for every request's streams.

name: closelog
suspicion: Closes the process-wide syslog connection another request opened with openlog().

name: copy
suspicion: Synchronous read/write copy of a plain file blocks the process for the whole copy.

name: display_startup_errors
suspicion: Process-wide PG(display_startup_errors) flag; startup already happened once per process, so a runtime change only affects other requests cosmetically.

name: docref_ext
suspicion: Process-wide PG(docref_ext) changes the manual links in every request's error messages.

name: docref_root
suspicion: Process-wide PG(docref_root) changes the manual links in every request's error messages.

name: error_append_string
suspicion: Process-wide PG(error_append_string) is appended to every request's displayed errors.

name: error_include_args
suspicion: Process-wide flag deciding whether other requests' error backtraces include argument values.

name: error_log
suspicion: Message type 0 goes to the process-wide PG(error_log) destination another request may have redirected.

name: error_log_mode
suspicion: Process-wide PG(error_log_mode) decides the mode of the error log file created for any request.

name: error_prepend_string
suspicion: Process-wide PG(error_prepend_string) is prepended to every request's displayed errors.

name: file
suspicion: Synchronous plain-file read blocks the process.

name: file_get_contents (plain files)
suspicion: Plain-file reads go through the unintercepted plain wrapper and block the process for the duration of the read (microseconds on local disk, indefinitely on NFS/FIFO).

name: file_put_contents (plain files)
suspicion: Blocking plain-file write; the LOCK_EX flag itself is intercepted via php_stream_lock().

name: flock
suspicion: Intercepted at php_stream_lock() so contention yields instead of blocking; only relevant for streams that bypass php_stream_lock.

name: fopen / fread / fwrite / fgets (plain files)
suspicion: Plain wrapper I/O is synchronous read(2)/write(2) on the process; large files or slow filesystems stall all requests.

name: from
suspicion: Process-wide FG(from_address) added as From: header to other requests' http:// wrapper calls.

name: getmyuid
suspicion: BG(page_uid) is cached once per process from the first script's stat; wrong only for pools serving scripts with different owners.

name: getrusage
suspicion: Reports CPU time of the whole process (all in-flight requests), not of this request.

name: highlight_file
suspicion: Synchronous plain-file read (also show_source, php_strip_whitespace) on the process.

name: html_errors
suspicion: Process-wide PG(html_errors) changes the formatting of every other request's error output.

name: ignore_repeated_errors
suspicion: Process-wide PG(ignore_repeated_errors) plus the shared PG(last_error_*) fields decide whether another request's identical error is suppressed.

name: ignore_repeated_source
suspicion: Process-wide PG(ignore_repeated_source) affects repeated-error suppression for every request.

name: implicit_flush
suspicion: Process-wide PG(implicit_flush) is read at request start for other requests' output layer setup.

name: input_encoding
suspicion: Process-wide PG(input_encoding) fallback used by mbstring/iconv input conversion for every request.

name: md5_file
suspicion: Synchronous plain-file read on the process.

name: memory_reset_peak_usage
suspicion: Resets the process-wide peak counter under other requests' feet, corrupting their peak statistics.

name: output_encoding
suspicion: Process-wide PG(output_encoding) fallback used by mbstring/iconv output conversion for every request.

name: parse_ini_file
suspicion: Synchronous plain-file read and parse on the process.

name: readfile
suspicion: Synchronous plain-file read pushed to output blocks the process for large files.

name: report_memleaks
suspicion: Process-wide PG(report_memleaks); leak reporting happens once per process anyway.

name: scandir / opendir / readdir / glob
suspicion: Directory enumeration is synchronous getdents on the process; big directories (session dirs, cache dirs) stall all requests.

name: sendmail_from
suspicion: Process-wide PG value (Windows mail() only).

name: sha1_file
suspicion: Synchronous plain-file read on the process.

name: shuffle
suspicion: Draws from the process-wide global random engine seeded by any request's mt_srand().

name: sleep
suspicion: Intercepted (handler swapped to a scheduler timer) so it yields; still blocks the process when called inside a nested user Fiber where the scheduler cannot be reached.

name: SMTP
suspicion: Process-wide PG value (Windows mail() only); harmless on POSIX but still a shared global written by ini_set.

name: smtp_port
suspicion: Process-wide PG value (Windows mail() only).

name: stat / filemtime / file_exists / is_file (stat family)
suspicion: Synchronous stat(2) on the process; slow only on network filesystems, but also shares the process-wide single-entry stat cache.

name: str_shuffle
suspicion: Draws from the process-wide global random engine seeded by any request's mt_srand().

name: stream_select
suspicion: Patched to suspend on the scheduler instead of select(); still blocks for plain-file or pipe descriptors that libevent cannot poll.

name: stream_socket_accept
suspicion: Blocking accept() on a server socket created inside a request stalls the process until a peer connects (rare in web code; TLS listeners from a fiber are refused).
evidence: fiber_errors.md (server-side ssl:// from fiber refused); main/streams/xp_socket.c

name: stream_wrapper_restore
suspicion: Restores a wrapper in the process-wide FG(stream_wrappers) that another request had unregistered on purpose.

name: syslog.filter
suspicion: Process-wide PG(syslog_filter) controls how every request's messages are filtered before syslog().

name: tempnam
suspicion: Creates a file with a blocking open/mkstemp on the process.

name: time_nanosleep
suspicion: Intercepted like sleep(); blocks only from a nested user Fiber.

name: tmpfile
suspicion: Blocking temporary file creation; the returned stream is a plain (blocking) stream.

name: url_rewriter.hosts
suspicion: on_modify rewrites the process-wide BG(url_adapt_*_hosts_ht) used by output rewriting for every request.

name: url_rewriter.tags
suspicion: on_modify rewrites the process-wide BG(url_adapt_*) tag tables used by output rewriting for every request.

name: user_agent
suspicion: OnUpdateStr writes FG(user_agent) process-wide, so http:// wrapper requests of other requests send this User-Agent.

name: usleep
suspicion: Intercepted like sleep(); blocks only from a nested user Fiber.

name: var_dump
suspicion: Float formatting follows the process-wide PG(precision)/PG(serialize_precision) set by ini_set in any request.

name: var_export
suspicion: Float formatting follows the process-wide PG(serialize_precision).

name: xmlrpc_error_number
suspicion: Process-wide PG(xmlrpc_error_number) used when xmlrpc_errors formats another request's error.

name: XMLReader::open
suspicion: Streaming reads of a local file are synchronous on the process.

name: XMLWriter::openUri
suspicion: Writes to a local file synchronously on the process.

name: class_exists
suspicion: Returns true for classes another request's script declared in the process-wide EG(class_table), so 'if (!class_exists(...))' feature-detection takes a different branch than in classic FPM.

name: defined
suspicion: Returns true for constants another in-flight request define()d in the process-wide EG(zend_constants), so guards like 'if (!defined(X)) define(X, ...)' skip their own definition.

name: error_reporting
suspicion: EG(error_reporting) is captured/restored per fiber switch and re-based at fiber start, so leakage is confined to the scheduler's main context; only the ini VALUE is shared and that is isolated per request.

name: fatal_error_backtraces
suspicion: Process-wide EG(fatal_error_backtrace_on) applies to every request's fatal errors.

name: fiber.stack_size
suspicion: Process-wide EG(fiber_stack_size) applies to user Fibers created by any request after the change.

name: gc_collect_cycles
suspicion: Runs the collector over the process-wide root buffer, pausing every in-flight request for a collection that mostly belongs to other requests.

name: gc_mem_caches
suspicion: Frees the allocator's cached chunks for the whole process, so one request's call changes allocation latency for all others.

name: max_execution_time
suspicion: There is one setitimer-driven Zend timeout per process, so the pool refuses fiber executors with a non-zero value; a runtime ini_set still arms the shared timer.

name: new class {} (anonymous classes in recompiled scripts)
suspicion: Every recompilation of an entry script adds a fresh class@anonymous entry to the process-wide EG(class_table) that is only destroyed at process shutdown (shutdown_executor runs once), so the table grows per request.
evidence: Zend/zend_vm_def.h:8057 (ZEND_DECLARE_ANON_CLASS looks up rtd_key in EG(class_table)); reasoning

name: zend.detect_unicode
suspicion: Process-wide CG(detect_unicode) affects compilation of files by other requests.

name: zend.exception_string_param_max_len
suspicion: Process-wide EG(exception_string_param_max_len) changes trace formatting for every request.

name: zend.script_encoding
suspicion: OnUpdateScriptEncoding sets the compiler's process-wide script encoding used while compiling other requests' files.

name: ZipArchive::open
suspicion: Synchronous plain-file read of the central directory.

name: gzopen / gzread / gzfile / readgzfile
suspicion: Compressed plain-file I/O is synchronous on the process.

name: zlib.output_compression_level
suspicion: Process-wide ZLIBG(output_compression_level) applies to every request's compressed output.

name: zlib.output_handler
suspicion: Process-wide ZLIBG(output_handler) name is used when other requests start output compression.
